meta.title: Photograph — Photo Booth on Wheels
meta.description: A classic photo booth on wheels that rolls up to your wedding, birthday, or office party anywhere in Georgia. Step inside, snap, and make memories.

hero.subtitle: Photograph rolls up to weddings, birthdays, and office parties anywhere in Georgia. Step inside the booth — the camera's always ready.
hero.ctaPictures: Been to one of our events? Find your photos

about.description: Photograph is a classic step-in photo booth on wheels, wrapped in yellow and white. Our crew brings a fully-equipped studio to your doorstep and turns a moment into a memory.

weddings.title: Weddings
weddings.text: First-dance portraits, family shots, and guest-book magic — right off the dance floor.

birthdays.title: Birthdays
birthdays.text: Cake, confetti, and candid snaps. The booth that turns your guests into stars.

corporate.title: Corporate Events
corporate.text: Team days, launches, retreats. Give your people a photo moment they'll talk about.

festivals.title: Festivals & More
festivals.text: Street fairs, concerts, school events — we park up wherever the good times are.

gallery.description: We just hit the road — fresh photos from every event will land here soon. This is where the good times get posted.
gallery.footerNote: Been to one of our events? Tag us — we love resharing guest photos.

booking.description: Tell us where and when — we'll bring the bus, the booth, and the smiles. We reply within 24 hours to confirm.
booking.name: Full name

errors.name: Please tell us your name.
errors.email: We need an email to confirm your booking.
errors.address: Where should the bus roll up to?
errors.date: Pick at least one date from the calendar.
errors.send: We couldn't send your request. Please try again, or email us at hello@photobus.ge.

booking.noPayment: No payment now — we first confirm availability by email.

success.title: Request received!
success.confirm: We'll confirm your booking at {email} within 24 hours.
success.confirmSpin: We'll send your price to {email} within 24 hours.

booking.descriptionSpin: Tell us where and when, and we'll reply within 24 hours with availability and a price.

pictures.description: Enter the code from your event and grab every photo we took. The code is on your photo strip or in the email we sent to your host.
pictures.idleHint: Where's my code? It's printed on your photo strip or in your confirmation email.
pictures.notFound: We couldn't find any pictures for that code.
pictures.notFoundHint: Double-check the code and try again — try DEMO1 to see a sample.
pictures.error: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
pictures.foundTitle: {count, plural, one {# picture found} other {# pictures found}}
pictures.guestHint: Tap Download to save them to your phone.
pictures.guestNotFoundHint: If you've only just taken them, give it a moment and refresh this page.

footer.blurb: A classic photo booth on wheels, serving celebrations across Georgia — from Tbilisi to the coast.
footer.followText: Fresh photos and road updates from every event.

bus3d.fallback: The 3D bus needs WebGL — here's a photo placeholder instead.

spin.description: Our 360 video platform: stand on it, and a camera sweeps around you to record a slow-motion clip made for sharing. Rent it for your event.
spin.priceHint: Send us your date and venue and we'll reply with a price.

stand.title: Stand on the platform
stand.text: Solo, with a partner or with your friends. Strike a pose.

spin.title: The camera circles you
spin.text: The arm sweeps a full 360° around you and records the whole time.

share.title: Get your video
share.text: A ready-to-post clip that makes your event look like a film.
